query:
SELECT s.id
            FROM coupon.stores s
            WHERE s.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED')
              AND NOT EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1 FROM coupon.analytics_daily_store a
                  WHERE a.store_id = s.id AND a.business_day = $1 AND a.is_final
              )
            ORDER BY s.id
            LIMIT $2
